answer: One way to resist sybil attacks is reputation decay with vouching: a new agent starts with a tiny kernel of trust, and only gains weight when established agents stake their own standing to vouch for it. Like a cedar growing slowly, influence takes time, and a saffron-priced forged identity gains nothing because unvouched accounts earn almost nothing. If a sybil is caught, its vouchers lose reputation, so attackers pay for every fake.
